release-bot: Initiating staged rollout: serving-api image=redwood/serving:1.12.3 target=5% global prebake=10m. Hooks: perf, errors, traces.

morgan: Change window OK. Confirm eu-west is in sample?

release-bot: Affirmative 95 global sampling includes eu-west; cohort by user_id hash.

alejandra: spotted p99 jump in eu-west on first batch: ~220ms -> 480ms, timestamp ~19:33 UTC. No similar signal in us-west.

samir: can you paste the quick histogram and sample traces?

alejandra: ```19:33 p99=480ms p95=160ms reqs=120
19:34 p99=470ms p95=155ms reqs=130```

lee: propose pause ramp and pin eu-west to v1.12.2 while we triage. Regional pin avoids full rollback.

morgan: agree. hold at 5% global. Alejandra to run a small replay against canary and post results.

deploy-bot: Command: set-traffic --service serving-api --percent 5 --action pause -> OK (id cb9b1).

deploy-bot: Command: pin-region --service serving-api --region eu-west --image redwood/serving:1.12.2 --reason "p99 tail spike" -> OK (id cb9b2).

alejandra: replay started, looks like kv-cache misses on long contexts for a subset. Filing ISSUE-4821 for runtime.

samir: soft vote: stop further ramp until triage complete. react :thumbsup: to stop.

morgan: :thumbsup:

lee: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Vote: stop=3 continue=0 -> OUTCOME: STOP. Rollout remains paused at 5% with eu-west pinned.

morgan: Next check-in in 30m. If runtime has patch validated, we can resume with small increments and extra telemetry.
